g1.label: 1. What time does the bus leave?
g1.why: The recording says the bus will leave at eight fifteen sharp.

g2.label: 2. What must every student bring?
g2.why: The recording says every student must bring their signed permission form.

g3.label: 3. What time does the museum close?
g3.why: The recording says the museum closes at four o'clock.

g4.label: 4. What time back at school?
g4.why: The recording says students will be back at school by five.

g5.label: 5. Why bring a raincoat?
g5.why: The recording says part of the visit includes an outdoor garden, so bring a raincoat if it rains.

g6.label: 6. What does Emma suggest instead of a thick coat?
g6.why: The recording says Emma suggests a light raincoat instead of a thick coat.

g7.label: 7. How much extra money for the gift shop?
g7.why: The recording says Emma suggests five or six pounds is enough.

g8.label: 8. What's not allowed near the dinosaurs?
g8.why: The recording says no flash photography is allowed near the dinosaurs.

g1.label: 1. Liam — control machines
g1.why: The text says the Robotics Zone lets you programme a robot to move.

g2.label: 2. Priya — prehistoric creatures
g2.why: The text says the Dinosaur Zone has a life-size skeleton and fossils.

g3.label: 3. Tom — dreams of being an astronaut
g3.why: The text says the Space Zone has a model of the International Space Station.

g4.label: 4. Emma — storms and hurricanes
g4.why: The text says the Weather Zone teaches how storms and hurricanes form.

g5.label: 5. Flash photography allowed
g5.why: The text says no flash photography is allowed in the Dinosaur Zone.

g6.label: 6. Stay behind yellow line
g6.why: The text confirms visitors must stay behind the yellow line in the Robotics Zone.

g7.label: 7. Café closes with museum
g7.why: The text says the café closes at 3:30pm, one hour before the museum.

g8.label: 8. Lockers are free
g8.why: The text says lockers cost £1, so they are not free.
